title: 第966章 彻底复刻大成水之真意第965章 瀚海龙雀戟
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
这一战，在孔渔看来，没有任何的悬念。
孔磊确实很强，甚至能够调动穹天鬼神之力，暂时性的形成天纹境修士所能形成的天地鬼神场域。
甚至能够施展出瀚海龙雀戟这门伪绝世秘术……
作为血孔雀一族的天骄妖孽，孔渔只是在李浪面前，显得卑微且孱弱，放在鬼兽族，放在人族中，都属于顶级妖孽了。
她的天赋，甚至比季风等妖孽都要更强。
所以，她自然是能够接触到血孔雀一族中的顶级秘术，像是伪绝世秘术，她自然了解。
绝世秘术，东域三大鬼兽族中，并无掌握，唯有神灵族四臂火神族中才有掌握。
故而，伪绝世秘术，已经基本上是孔磊所能施展出的最强秘术了。
但是……
李浪可是掌握了绝世刀法，甚至还学会了四臂火神族的那门绝世鬼神秘术，黄金狮火剑印啊！
这么一个怪物，孔磊怎么赢的了？
孔渔摇了摇头。
她从未这般信赖过一个人。
除非这个人，是李浪。
陈丹求也是呵呵笑着，对于孔磊这位半步天纹，并不看好。
因为他的对手，是浪爷啊。
……
……
轰隆隆——
瀚海龙雀戟！

伪绝世鬼神秘术，威能达到了极致，让孔磊内心极致膨胀，斩杀眼前这个人族的信心，越来越强烈！
“唰！！！”
龙雀横亘，戟芒贯空！
孔磊没有浪费时间，猛地一步踏出，手中的三叉戟悍然扫出，面前的空间都好似剧烈的扭曲起来！
一粒粒从高空俯冲而下的豆大雨珠，瞬间被撞碎，炸的支离破碎，迷蒙成水雾翻涌！
涛涛汹涌的戟芒以及鬼神之力，迸发而出，幻化成为无数的戟芒，戟芒如洪流，铺天盖地的对着李浪斩杀而去！
强大的穹天场域，狠狠的压迫而下，要让李浪行动遭受限制，将他封锁在当场！
而李浪眸光一凝，霸王枪横扫而出，鬼武秘术配合霸王枪，让这一枪的威力达到顶峰！
黄金火焰跳动，熊熊燃烧，像是化作一种披着黄金火焰甲胄的战神，贯出长枪，与龙雀碰撞！
当——！！！
清脆至极的碰撞声音响彻！
火花四溅而开，水流炸裂，火焰跳动，大成水之真意与大成火之真意碰撞之下，彼此对抗，嗤嗤嗤声间，蒸腾起灼热气流！
狂暴的劲风，凌厉无比，朝着四周扩散，二人周围的空间，都荡漾起了阵阵涟漪，掀动尘泥，卷动狂风！
孔磊眸光肆意，银芒流转，穹天之力压制，让他战意沛然。
他疯狂的舞动三叉戟，不断的压制着李浪，要将李浪给彻底格杀！
二者连续进行招式上的碰撞。
血红色的发丝飞扬，孔磊很明显将李浪给压制住了，这让孔磊唇角扬起了森冷的弧度。
倏地。
三叉戟一卷，那缠绕水龙的水孔雀，将会瞬息出现在李浪的身后。
孔雀爪狠狠的朝着李浪的背脊抓去，要破开甲胄，撕裂血肉！

李浪回首扫了一眼，五指攥握，蟒龙七杀拳悍然爆发，气血喷薄，极武洗髓开门的强横肉身，丝毫不弱于远古凶兽。
与这龙雀碰撞一招，硬生生以肉身硬抗，竟是毫发无损！
content_en:
In Kong Yu's view, there was no suspense in this battle.
Kong Lei is indeed very strong, and can even mobilize the power of the sky, ghosts and gods to temporarily form a field of heaven and earth ghosts and gods that can be formed by monks in the sky pattern realm.
He can even perform the pseudo-peerless secret technique of Vast Sea Dragon Bird Halberd...
As a genius monster of the Blood Peacock Clan, Kong Yu only looked humble and weak in front of Li Lang. He was considered a top monster among both the Ghost Beast Clan and the Human Race.
Her talent is even stronger than that of Ji Feng and other monsters.
Therefore, she naturally has access to the top secret techniques of the Blood Peacock clan, such as pseudo-peerless secret techniques, and she naturally understands them.
This peerless secret technique is not mastered by any of the three major ghost beast clans in the Eastern Region. Only the four-armed Vulcan clan of the Spirit Clan can master it.
Therefore, the pseudo-peerless secret technique is basically the strongest secret technique that Kong Lei can perform.
But...
Li Lang has mastered peerless sword skills, and even learned the peerless ghost and mysterious technique of the Four-Armed Vulcan Clan, the Golden Lion Fire Sword Seal!
How could Kong Lei win against such a monster?
Kong Yu shook his head.
She had never trusted someone so much.
Unless this person is Li Lang.
Chen Danqiu also laughed and was not optimistic about Kong Lei, the Half-Step Heaven Mark.
Because his opponent is Mr. Lang.
…
…
Rumble——
Vast Sea Dragon Bird Halberd!
The power of the pseudo-peerless ghost mystic technique reached its extreme, which made Kong Lei's heart expand to the extreme. His confidence in killing the human race in front of him became stronger and stronger!
"Uh-huh!!!"
Dragons and birds are flying across the sky, and halberds are shining through the sky!
Kong Lei wasted no time, stepped forward with a sudden step, and swept out the trident in his hand. The space in front of him seemed to be violently distorted!
The large raindrops that swooped down from high altitude were instantly smashed, exploded into pieces, and turned into mist!
The turbulent halberd awns and the power of ghosts and gods burst out, transforming into countless halberd awns. The halberd awns were like a torrent, overwhelming and killing Li Lang!
The powerful dome field was pressing down hard, trying to restrict Li Lang's movements and seal him on the spot!
Li Lang's eyes narrowed, and the Overlord Spear swept out. The secret technique of ghost martial arts combined with the Overlord Spear made the power of this spear reach its peak!
The golden flame jumps and burns fiercely, as if it has transformed into a god of war wearing a golden flame armor, thrusting out a spear and colliding with the dragon bird!
when--! ! !
The crisp and clear collision sound resounded!
Sparks splashed out, water flow exploded, and flames jumped. The true meaning of Dacheng Water and the true meaning of Dacheng Fire collided and fought against each other. Amidst the chissing sounds, hot air steamed up!
The violent wind was so fierce that it spread in all directions. The space around the two of them was filled with ripples, stirring up the dust and mud, and whipping up the violent wind!
Kong Lei's eyes were wild, the silver light was flowing, and the power of the sky suppressed him, making him full of fighting spirit.
He waved the trident crazily, constantly suppressing Li Lang, and wanted to kill Li Lang completely!
The two collided with each other continuously.
Blood-red hair was flying, and it was obvious that Kong Lei had suppressed Li Lang, which made the corners of Kong Lei's lips curl up in a cold arc.
Suddenly.
With a roll of the trident, the water peacock wrapped around the water dragon will appear behind Li Lang in an instant.
The peacock claws clawed hard at Li Lang's back, trying to break open the armor and tear apart the flesh and blood!
Li Lang glanced back, clenched his five fingers, and violently exploded with the Seven Killing Fists of the Python Dragon. His energy and blood spurted out, and his tyrannical body that opened the door through the most powerful marrow cleansing was no weaker than the ancient ferocious beast.
He collided with this dragon bird and resisted with his body, but he was unscathed!
